items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe') and the interviewee responds to his introduction. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Chico was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York City at the IAJE convention. I’m very pleased to have Chico Freeman with me today, who is a saxophonist and a multi-instrumentalist and in general doing what it takes to be in the music business. Is that a fair assumption?
Yeah. Doing a few things that are involved in the music, yeah.
